ownerCookie.name: forgeflow_session
ownerCookie.description: Owner session cookie. POST requires matching X-CSRF-Token.

project_id.description: Must equal the project path parameter.

estimate_id.description: New document identity for each appended estimate; no imposed ID format.

task_id.description: Must identify a current task in this project.

task_revision.description: Must equal the current authoritative task revision.

estimate_version.description: Exactly one plus the retained maximum for this task_id and task_revision; first version is 1.

duration_hours.description: Optional reviewed elapsed duration in hours, independent of effort. Omission and null both mean unknown.

revision.description: Required DTO field. The server replaces it with document revision 1 when creating a new estimate.

TaskEstimate.title: TaskEstimate
TaskEstimate.description: POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/task-estimates body and persisted record. Owner-authenticated append-only authority command requiring Idempotency-Key. Unknown fields are rejected. Database history, current-task binding and cross-field effort ordering are validated by the server.

EffortEstimate.description: Reviewed work effort in hours. The server also checks optimistic_hours <= likely_hours <= pessimistic_hours; JSON Schema does not express this cross-field ordering. Effort is not elapsed calendar duration.

read_model_version.description: Equals data.revision, the project observation cursor.

PlanningInputsResponse.title: PlanningInputsResponse
PlanningInputsResponse.description: GET /api/v1/projects/{project}/planning-inputs response. Owner-authenticated, unpaged PostgreSQL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY snapshot. All input collections and counters share one MVCC observation; no execution rights or result bytes are granted.

ResourceVector.description: All seven resource dimensions are required, including zeros. CPU units and memory bytes are integer resource-policy units; this vector does not prove OS or provider enforcement.

envelope.description: Existing canonical execution-envelope DTO; its presence does not grant a lease or execution permission.

value.description: Retained queue document. Scenario extraction reads task_id and priority; this generic document collection has no enforced complete DTO schema.

tasks.description: Current tasks except REMOVED_FROM_PLAN, ordered by task_id; completed tasks remain present.

resource_policies.description: Project policies plus all global/worker policies whose project_id is null.

resource_limits.description: Current authoritative counters for those policies. Scenario computation requires exactly seven dimension rows per policy.

completed_task_ids.description: Tasks with SUCCEEDED attempts matching the current task_revision.

active_task_ids.description: Project task IDs with an attempt whose terminal_at is null; not a live-process or qualification assertion.

revision.description: Project event_seq observed in this snapshot, not a planning object revision.

planning_input_digest.description: Server-opaque semantic planning digest. Includes task definitions without revision/fence_epoch, teams, owner/estimate/schedule documents, queue task ID/priority, resource policies and completed task IDs. Excludes event cursor, allocation counters, active IDs, project DTO and observation times. Clients must echo it rather than recompute it.

as_of.description: Database clock timestamp sampled during the repeatable-read transaction; envelope observed_at is sampled later by the API.

input_revision.description: Required project event cursor from planning-inputs. Guarded exactly only when planning_input_digest is omitted/null.

planning_input_digest.description: Echo the server-opaque planning-inputs digest. When present, this guard takes precedence over input_revision; fresh allocation counters may differ.

availability.description: Positive, nonoverlapping working intervals inside the outer bounds. Empty/omitted means one interval using start_at/end_at. Their first-to-last span must not exceed 366 days; jobs must fit a whole interval.

worker_scope_id.description: Optional scope_id whose snapshot resource policy has a non-null worker_id. This does not verify a live worker or its execution binding.

task_ids.description: Current snapshot task IDs. Empty/omitted selects all unfinished tasks. Dependencies are not added automatically; selecting only a successor can produce MISSING_PREDECESSOR.

duration_overrides.description: Positive elapsed-duration hours keyed by a current task ID. Override keys need not be in the selected subset; unknown keys are rejected.

PlanningScenarioRequest.title: PlanningScenarioRequest
PlanningScenarioRequest.description: POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/planning-scenarios request. Computes a read-only forecast from a fresh repeatable-read snapshot; persists no scenario or schedule and requires no Idempotency-Key. Owner authentication is required; cookie POSTs still require X-CSRF-Token. The server checks end_at > start_at, interval ordering, task existence and graph/window budgets.

dependency_lower_bound_hours.description: Dependency-only lower bound, excluding resource/calendar waits; null if input dependencies/durations are invalid or there are no planned tasks.

complete.description: True only when every selected unfinished planning task receives a forecast row.

input_changed_since_request.description: Reports only whether the project event cursor differs from requested_revision. A matching digest can succeed when this is true.

worker_placement.description: EXPLICIT_SCOPE means a resource-policy scope was requested, not verified live placement or Worker qualification.

revision.description: Reviewed parent object revision, compared inside the save transaction.

source_revision.description: Reviewed requirement source digest; must match supplied and current authoritative CompileContext.

FlowParentGuard.description: Optional reviewed assignment guard. Requires a new DRAFT child, matching parent_revision, higher flow_revision, context present and expected_revision absent/null. The server rejects retained-task Owner/team changes while an attempt has terminal_at null. Saving grants no execution rights.

flow.description: Canonical FlowRevision from crates/domain/src/model.rs; this inventory does not expand its complete validation schema.

context.description: Canonical CompileContext from crates/planner/src/lib.rs. Required and non-null when parent_guard is present.

FlowWrite.description: Flow draft create/update. FlowWrite itself ignores unknown fields; canonical FlowRevision and CompileContext reject them. Server recomputes supplied semantic digests. Reviewed guarded saves create proposals requiring checks and the separate commit command.
